fact: The World Bank ISR (dated 2023-12-12) records the project indicator 'A government-wide cloud strategy developed and disseminated' as No at baseline (2021-12-31), No in January 2023 and No at the current reading of 2023-09-01, against a Yes target of 2026-12-31, commenting only that a strategy 'is discussed by the Government'; no drafting is stated.
